settings.bronze_offsets_have_gaps: yes: the CDC topics compact (cleanup.policy=compact,delete), so superseded versions never reach bronze, and the forget DELETE removes subject rows; kafka offsets in bronze are not contiguous on these topics
settings.wording: deletion propagation verified in this system; per sink 'logical' (by query) and 'physical' (by bytes) or 'bounded, not removed'; no compliance claim
settings.note: ids, canaries and emails are never printed or stored in this check
